name: Toxic chemical releases by county (EPA Toxics Release Inventory)
description: Toxic chemicals that industrial and federal facilities reported releasing on site to the Environmental Protection Agency's Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) in reporting year 2024, for 2,437 counties with a reporting facility, 56 states and territories and the US: 21,482 facilities and 2,842,308,160 pounds in all (530,322,130 to air, 188,664,266 to water, 2,123,321,764 to land), with the pounds of known or suspected carcinogens, PFAS, ethylene oxide, benzene and lead, and the on-site total of each of the earlier years kept (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023). State records list the three largest parent companies. Counties carry the Census FIPS code. Dioxin-like compounds, which facilities report in grams, are converted to pounds. TRI counts reported releases by listed chemicals from covered facilities; it is not a measure of exposure or of harm.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Toxic chemical releases by county (EPA Toxics Release Inventory) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964168

distribution.name: toxic-releases.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: toxic-releases.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: toxic-releases-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in toxic-releases-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to toxic-releases.csv on id.

recordSet.name: toxic-releases
recordSet.description: The records of Toxic chemical releases by county (EPA Toxics Release Inventory), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state, DC or territory, or US

field.name: level
field.description: county, state (states and territories) or us

field.name: reportingYear
field.description: TRI reporting year of the figures

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Same as onsite_lbs: pounds released on site in the latest reporting year

field.name: unit
field.description: What the value counts

field.name: facilities
field.description: Facilities that filed a TRI form for the place that year

field.name: onsite_lbs
field.description: Total on-site releases in pounds: to air, water, land and underground, including disposal in landfills

field.name: air_lbs
field.description: Fugitive and stack air releases in pounds

field.name: water_lbs
field.description: Releases to surface water in pounds

field.name: land_lbs
field.description: Releases to land in pounds: underground injection, landfills, land treatment, surface impoundments and other disposal

field.name: carcinogens_lbs
field.description: On-site pounds of chemicals TRI flags as known or suspected carcinogens (includes ethylene oxide and benzene)

field.name: pfas_lbs
field.description: On-site pounds of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances on the TRI list

field.name: ethylene_oxide_lbs
field.description: On-site pounds of ethylene oxide

field.name: benzene_lbs
field.description: On-site pounds of benzene

field.name: lead_lbs
field.description: On-site pounds of lead and lead compounds

field.name: onsite_lbs_2024
field.description: On-site releases in pounds in reporting year 2024

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the reporting year

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the reporting year

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
